text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: That race gave us a lot of great takeaways to learn from.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: The one who took first place was particularly impressive.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Her positioning during the race, her line choice at the end,
the timing of her surge... Everything was magnificent.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
――If I want to win against someone like that,
how should I be running……?
choice_data_list: It's best to shake things up and disrupt their pace.
Mark her tightly and don't let her run as she pleases.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Ah... I see.
So you do that so they can't save their legs, right?

After that, I had an in-depth discussion
with Grass Wonder about the tactical mind games
used to put pressure on opponents.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
I see...
"Flexibility yields more strength than brute force," is that it?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Being heavily marked makes it hard to run...
That's a good strategy.

After that, I spent some time quietly discussing
with Grass Wonder how to pace herself
while keeping tabs on tough rivals.
